name: library-surface
body: The crate-internal API of the apg root crate that tests outside the declaring module reach: the module tree and the functions/structs the inline tests currently call directly (`testutil` builders, `ingest::ingest`, `cache::CacheKey::compute`, `layers::read_node_file`, `plan_cmd::plan_verify_at`, …). It exists so white-box tests can move out of the source module tree without losing access to the code under test.
